stages.title: Yuk profili, kapasite ve geri basinc kanitini kapat
stages.objective: Mevcut yerel performans harness'lerinin hedef, orneklem, route, backpressure, idempotency ve hard-zero metriklerini olculebilir bir kapasite sozlesmesine baglamak; eski raporlarin tarihsel oldugunu acikca ayirmak.
stages.scope: Stage 5 ve Stage 7 local-lab performance harness'leri, Phase 79G bounded production-scale rehearsal, mevcut performance evidence JSON dosyalari ve bunlarin real-egress sinirlari.
prerequisites: Phase 5 CLOSED olmali; closure ve bes stage digest'i gecerli olmali.
Performance harness kaynaklari ve Phase 79G sample testi mevcut olmali.
Audit kosusunda remote/provider egress flag'leri false olmali.
architectureDecisions: Browser performance kaniti sadece loopback local-lab verisi olarak yorumlanir; field Core Web Vitals veya production GO olarak yorumlanmaz.
P75 LCP, CLS, TBT ve interaction proxy hedefleri harness icindeki TARGETS sabitlerinden okunur; yeni esik uydurulmaz.
Phase 79G hard-zero metrikleri aggregate-only ve sifir hata politikasi ile korunur.
Tarihi evidence sourceRevision mevcut HEAD ile ayni degilse stale olarak isaretlenir; stale rapor current-code PASS yerine gecmez.
Canli production traffic, linked Supabase ve uzak veritabanina baglanilmaz.
Gercek WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe veya harici LLM/provider egress acilmaz.
Destructive chaos, remote restore, remote worker start ve production deploy calistirilmaz.
Kanita ait dosyalar docs/system-audit/phase-6 ve .manu-runtime/system-audit/phase-6 ile sinirlidir.
operations: Phase 5 closure precondition'ini ve current Git HEAD'i oku; source commit uyumsuzsa dur.
Stage 5 ve Stage 7 harness kaynaklari ile gereken report dosyalarinin varligini kontrol et.
Local loopback hedeflerini ve performance harness davranisini envantere al.
P75 hedeflerini, route sayisini, sample count'i ve strict/non-strict davranisini kaynak koddan cikar.
Phase 79G aggregate workload, hard-zero metrikleri, sample/full ayrimini ve release rehearsal zincirini kontrol et.
Mevcut performance evidence dosyalarini status, productionStatus, target ve sourceRevision alanlariyla karsilastir.
Current audit ortaminda remote Supabase/provider egress ve production mutation bayraklarinin kapali oldugunu; matrix inputlari ile local-only NO-GO final blocker listesini kontrol et.
Phase 79G bounded rehearsal testini calistir; PASS ise matrix, operation evidence ve source digestlerini docs/system-audit/phase-6 altinda yaz.
stages.dataFlow: local Next server/harness -> bounded browser samples -> P75 metrics -> Phase 79G aggregate rehearsal -> hard-zero decision -> secret-free capacity matrix.
stages.completionCriteria: load-capacity-matrix.json status PASS, eight operations PASS ve stage evidence VERIFIED olmadan 6.2 acilmaz.

stages.title: Ariza enjeksiyonu, retry ve fail-closed davranisini kapat
stages.objective: Queue/worker, AI run, rate limit ve API error yollarinda dependency failure, timeout, lease, retry, terminal failure, duplicate ve request-id davranislarini destructive olmayan deterministic testlerle kanitlamak.
stages.scope: Durable media/audio/AI worker lifecycle'lari, rate limiter, API error contract'i, request-id propagation ve Phase 79G safety failure aggregation.
prerequisites: Test kosusunda real provider ve remote RLS flag'leri false
architectureDecisions: Dependency failure client'a ham exception olarak degil, bounded structured error veya durable terminal outcome olarak yansir.
Retry sadece retryable failure'larda ilerler; lease token/tenant scope/idempotency korunmadan tekrar isleme izin verilmez.
Rate limit backend RPC hata verirse request allow edilmez; local fallback sadece acik dev fallback kosulunda kullanilir.
AI run timeout/abort/failure event ile kapanir; provider egress kapali iken deterministic provider gate korunur.
Canli production traffic, linked Supabase ve uzak veritabanina baglanilmaz.
Gercek WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe veya harici LLM/provider egress acilmaz.
Destructive chaos, remote restore, remote worker start ve production deploy calistirilmaz.
Kanita ait dosyalar docs/system-audit/phase-6 ve .manu-runtime/system-audit/phase-6 ile sinirlidir.
operations: 6.1 VERIFIED precondition'ini ve source/evidence digestlerini dogrula.
Media ve audio worker kaynaklarinin mevcut oldugunu ve claim, lease renewal, timeout, retry, release ve terminal failure yollarini cikart.
AI run service kaynaklarinda timeout, abort, run.failed, retryable ve stale-context kapanislarini kontrol et.
Rate-limit RPC, 429 response, Retry-After ve fail-closed hata yolunu kontrol et.
Duplicate/idempotency, revision veya lease token guard'larini tenant scope ile birlikte kontrol et.
Request-id ve structured error propagation testlerini calistir; PII/secret leakage olmamasini kontrol et.
Failure matrix inputlarini, remote/provider boundary'sini ve final blocker listesini kontrol et.
Deterministic worker, AI ve rate-limit test grubunu calistir; PASS ise matrix ve operation evidence dosyasini source commit/digest ile yaz.
stages.dataFlow: dependency/timeout -> worker or service failure classifier -> retry/terminal state -> bounded API/event error -> requestId/audit evidence -> operator-visible aggregate.
verificationCriteria: all failure paths have explicit outcome
stages.completionCriteria: failure-injection-matrix.json status PASS, eight operations PASS ve stage evidence VERIFIED olmadan 6.3 acilmaz.

stages.title: Gozlemlenebilirlik, health ve alarm sinyali sozlesmesini kapat
stages.objective: Release health, admin health, operational snapshot, shell metric sink, worker operations ve adapter rollback sinyallerinin cache, privacy, request-id, fail-closed ve operator kararlarini destekleyen sozlesmesini kanitlamak.
stages.scope: Health API route'lari, operational-health snapshot, metric sanitization, channel adapter health/rollback, worker release manifest ve structured error surface.
prerequisites: health ve metrics test kaynaklari mevcut
architectureDecisions: Health endpointleri no-store olur; release identity ve dependency failure sonucu bounded status verir.
Operational snapshot aggregate-only'dir; client body, phone, raw prompt, secret veya raw URL tasimaz.
Metric sink route ve responsive class allowlist'i kullanir; clientId/raw URL alanlari reddedilir.
Adapter rollback global/tenant/dietitian/client scope'ta outbound automation'i fail-closed durdurur ve audit event uretir.
Worker operations manifest production GO, release verification, runbook ve rollback owner olmadan ready karari vermez.
Canli production traffic, linked Supabase ve uzak veritabanina baglanilmaz.
Gercek WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe veya harici LLM/provider egress acilmaz.
Destructive chaos, remote restore, remote worker start ve production deploy calistirilmaz.
Kanita ait dosyalar docs/system-audit/phase-6 ve .manu-runtime/system-audit/phase-6 ile sinirlidir.
operations: 6.2 VERIFIED precondition'ini ve digest zincirini dogrula.
Release health ve commercial admin health route kaynaklarinin mevcut oldugunu; status, timeout, no-store ve dependency failure davranisini kontrol et.
Operational health snapshot alanlarini aggregate-only ve launch-blocking sinyallerle eslestir.
Shell metric sink sanitize/allowlist ve raw URL/clientId reddini kontrol et.
Channel adapter health counters ve rollback scope'larinin audit/fail-closed davranisini kontrol et.
Worker release manifest, one-shot command ve production readiness blocker'larini kontrol et.
Observability matrix inputlarini, remote/provider boundary'sini ve final blocker listesini kontrol et.
Health, metric, rollback, worker ve privacy test grubunu calistir; PASS ise matrix ve operation evidence dosyasini source commit/digest ile yaz.
stages.dataFlow: dependency/worker/channel state -> bounded health counters -> no-store route or operator snapshot -> sanitized metric/alert signal -> rollback or incident decision.
verificationCriteria: health routes are no-store and bounded
rollback and worker blockers are explicit
stages.completionCriteria: observability-contract-matrix.json status PASS, eight operations PASS ve stage evidence VERIFIED olmadan 6.4 acilmaz.

stages.title: Backup, restore, worker ve rollback kurtarma kanitini kapat
stages.objective: Backup/restore scriptlerinin dry-run, encryption, hash, isolated target, approval, cleanup ve secret handling kurallarini; worker one-shot ve rollback runbook'inin uygulanabilir operasyon sozlesmesini kanitlamak.
stages.scope: Hosted Supabase backup/restore helper'lari, manifest/approval validator, release worker manifesti, Phase 5 operations runbook, incident ve backup/restore runbook'lari.
prerequisites: Remote restore ve production apply kapali
architectureDecisions: Backup default dry-run'dir; remote backup explicit approval olmadan reddedilir.
Backup age ile sifrelenir, SHA-256 manifest'e yazilir ve dump/decrypted gecici dosya finally ile silinir.
Restore source-target ref esitligini, hash mismatch'i, expired/missing approval'i ve confirmation mismatch'i reddeder.
Worker production start'i service-role env, production GO, release verification, runbook approval ve rollback owner olmadan blocked'dir.
Rollback traffic release artifact'a geri doner, provider/channel flag'leri kapatilir ve one-shot worker kontrolu yapilir.
Canli production traffic, linked Supabase ve uzak veritabanina baglanilmaz.
Gercek WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe veya harici LLM/provider egress acilmaz.
Destructive chaos, remote restore, remote worker start ve production deploy calistirilmaz.
Kanita ait dosyalar docs/system-audit/phase-6 ve .manu-runtime/system-audit/phase-6 ile sinirlidir.
operations: 6.3 VERIFIED precondition'ini ve digest zincirini dogrula.
Backup/restore kaynaklarinin mevcut oldugunu; backup scriptinin default dry-run ve remote approval gate'ini kontrol et.
Encryption, SHA-256 manifest, database URL secret redaction ve gecici dump cleanup'i kontrol et.
Restore hash, source-target isolation, approval schema, confirmation ve expiry kontrollerini kontrol et.
Worker long-running/one-shot komutlarini, required env ve production readiness blocker'larini runbook ile karsilastir.
Incident/backup restore/rollback runbook'larinin production NO-GO ve evidence kayit adimlarini kontrol et.
Recovery matrix inputlarini, remote restore boundary'sini ve runbook evidence final listesini kontrol et.
Backup/restore, manifest ve worker release test grubunu remote apply yapmadan calistir; PASS ise matrix ve operation evidence dosyasini source commit/digest ile yaz.
stages.dataFlow: backup request -> project/ref gate -> pg_dump child env -> age encrypted artifact + manifest -> isolated target approval -> hash/restore validation -> cleanup -> rollback evidence.
verificationCriteria: secrets stay out of process args/output
stages.completionCriteria: recovery-operations-matrix.json status PASS, eight operations PASS ve stage evidence VERIFIED olmadan 6.5 acilmaz.

stages.title: Faz 6 final kapanisini ve Faz 7 gecis kilidini ac
stages.objective: Faz 6'nin dort teknik stage'ini, output/evidence digest zincirini, final contract/test/typecheck sonucunu ve mutation boundary'sini tekrar dogrulayarak fazi kapatmak.
stages.scope: Phase 6 state, stage output/evidence dosyalari, final targeted tests, typecheck sonucu ve next-phase gate.
architectureDecisions: Faz sadece tum stage operasyonlari PASS, digestler gecerli, final testler PASS ve boundary kapali ise CLOSED olur.
Kapanis evidence'i production GO veya remote recovery approval anlamina gelmez; NO-GO sinirlari korunur.
Faz 7 sadece gate olarak acilir; Faz 7 uygulamasi bu fazin kapsaminda degildir.
Canli production traffic, linked Supabase ve uzak veritabanina baglanilmaz.
Gercek WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe veya harici LLM/provider egress acilmaz.
Destructive chaos, remote restore, remote worker start ve production deploy calistirilmaz.
Kanita ait dosyalar docs/system-audit/phase-6 ve .manu-runtime/system-audit/phase-6 ile sinirlidir.
operations: 6.1-6.4 stage state'lerinin VERIFIED oldugunu sirayla dogrula.
Her stage output ve evidence SHA-256 digest'ini yeniden hesapla.
Phase 6 plan manifesti, source commit ve mutation policy tutarliligini kontrol et.
Phase 6 contract testini calistir.
Final targeted reliability/recovery test grubunu tekrar calistir.
Typecheck'i remote/provider egress kapali ortamda calistir.
Tum blocker listelerini ve operation status'lerini sifirla; herhangi bir hata varsa kapanisi BLOCKED yap.
Closure evidence, phase closure ve nextPhaseUnlocked kayitlarini digest'leyerek yaz.
stages.dataFlow: stage evidence -> digest revalidation -> final tests/typecheck -> blocker evaluation -> CLOSED state -> phase-6 closure -> phase-7 gate.
verificationCriteria: closure record is immutable for current source commit
stages.completionCriteria: phase-6-closure-evidence.json status PASS, eight operations PASS, state CLOSED ve phase-6-closure.json nextPhaseUnlocked=true olmadan Faz 6 kapanmaz.
